parsed.internal_thinking: Shon is trying to hustle for resources. He knows I just got wood from the 11 roll. Ziv was smart to decline the sheep-for-brick trade because bricks are valuable right now, especially with Ziv's city production. I need to be careful with Shon; he's friendly now but he's a backstabber. I'll acknowledge his comment about the wood without committing to anything yet. I only have one wood and I might need it for a road myself.
parsed.note_to_self: Shon is actively hunting for wood and bricks to expand towards the corner. Ziv is holding onto his bricks despite the offer. I have 1 wood from the last roll.
